title: Gumroad - free API
snippet:
Gumroad is a platform for selling digital products, and its free API lets developers verify software license keys, fetch product and sale data, and manage resources programmatically. Any free Gumroad account can generate an API token from Settings, Advanced, and there is no monthly cost to use the API. The license verification endpoint is the most popular, letting desktop and web apps check that a customer's key is valid. Gumroad takes a transaction fee on sales, but the API itself is free.

### Get free access
Open the provider's signup page and make a free account.
[Sign up for Gumroad ↗](https://gumroad.com)

**Access**Free key (no card)
**Rate limit**Gumroad publishes no fixed API quota; avoid polling and use webhooks for sale notifications instead.

title: Gumroad MCP: connect Gumroad to AI agents and automations
snippet:
Gumroad has no subscription plans, which makes the usual question on a page like this unusually simple to answer. There is no Pro tier, no Business tier and no monthly bill, so there is no plan for API access to sit behind. Gumroad's published pricing is a per-transaction cut and nothing else: 10 percent plus 50 cents on sales through your own profile and direct links, and 30 percent when a new customer finds you through Gumroad's Discover marketplace. Any account can create an application, generate an access token and call the API immediately. Nothing on this page is gated behind an upgrade, and there is no free tier exclusion list to read, because there is no paid tier to be excluded from.

Gumroad issues access tokens from its own account settings rather than from a separate developer portal: open Settings, then Advanced, and use the application form there. You create an application, then generate an access token for your own account from it, which is the credential this connector takes. There is no purchase step and no review queue in front of it, because Gumroad sells no plans and gates nothing here behind billing.

Do I need a paid Gumroad plan to use the API?
No, and the reason is worth stating plainly rather than hedging, because it is unusual. Gumroad does not sell subscription plans at all. There is no monthly bill, no Pro tier and no Business tier, so there is no plan for API access to sit behind and no free tier exclusion list to read. Gumroad's published pricing is per transaction and taken only when you sell something: 10 percent plus 50 cents on sales through your own profile and direct links, and 30 percent on sales where a new customer finds you through the Discover marketplace. Creating an application and generating an access token is available to any Gumroad account. One endpoint does not even need that: license verification requires no credential and no application whatsoever.
